title: Farmer Scarlett
dek: A Pristinian civilian whose wartime work makes survival a matter of water, bedding, labor and space.

facts.Record: Public scenes; later status not established

sources: Main quest-RP archive · message anchors below
NPC Master Registry and Recovery Map · recovery lead, checked against raw scenes
body:
Civilian judgment

Scarlett supports the adventurers during the Rahu crisis, but reports her husband’s different expectation: that an attack might target the Gate and leave residents alone. This is a household’s belief under pressure, not an established enemy plan.

Keeping the shelter usable

During the emergency, Scarlett carries water, directs others to move injured people and valuables into temporary shelter, and asks for freshwater, bedding, shovels and wooden supports. She reports room for about sixty people at that moment, while warning that labor and structural support are inadequate. The figure describes the shelter she sees, not a permanent town capacity. Her fatigue gives the crisis a civilian scale.

A bond beyond the farm

In an earlier woodland outing, she describes Sami as her bonded companion, trained since he was a cub, and rides with him through the woods. The scene preserves another part of Scarlett’s life without replacing her civilian work with a combat biography.

Recorded scenes

  • An attributed household belief during the siege
  • Moving people and valuables into shelter
  • Space, labor and structural supports
  • The cost of carrying water
  • Scarlett’s bond with Sami
